items.name: narration_hi
items.direction: Narrate this as a high-energy 'what if' geography Short for BHUGOL, a popular geography fun-facts YouTube channel, in natural spoken Hindi like a top Indian geography explainer channel. The Narrator is SUPER excited, practically bursting with energy: a hyped-up, thrilled YouTube host who can't believe how cool this story is and can't wait to tell you. Huge smile in the voice the whole way, bright and punchy, loud-ish and lively. Wide, dramatic pitch movement: rise with real wonder on every question, hit every number with genuine amazement ('WOW' energy), build excitement through each line, and land each punchline with a grin after a tiny comic pause. 'Twist ये है' gets a playful, knowing, excited lift. 'लेकिन ये अभी सबसे अजीब बात नहीं है' is whispered-excited, leaning in like a secret. The three capitals 'Tallinn? Riga? Vilnius?' are asked like a quick, rising, playful quiz. 'वो तो Finnish के करीब है।' is deadpan and funny. Numbers and English words (place names, language names, million, kilometer, chain, capital, twist, Europe, E-U) are spoken in English, naturally, the way Indian creators mix them. The last line trails off unfinished on 'क्योंकि सच बताऊं...', voice staying up, so it loops straight back into the first line. Pace is quick and bouncy with short crisp pauses; never slow, flat, calm, sleepy, bored or documentary-serious. VOICE IDENTITY: always the same warm baritone host, same person and same high energy level throughout. Say GTA as the letters G-T-A. Pronounce 'Tallinn' as 'TAL-in', 'Riga' as 'REE-gah', 'Vilnius' as 'VIL-nee-us', 'Lithuania' as 'lith-oo-AY-nee-ah'. Read ONLY the text provided, word for word, every line in order; never add words of your own.
lines: अगर Estonia, Latvia और Lithuania... एक देश बन जाएं?
Twist ये है: एक दिन के लिए, ये तीनों एक बन चुके हैं।
Nineteen eighty-nine में, two million लोगों ने हाथ पकड़े...
एक बिना टूटी chain में... six hundred seventy-five kilometer लंबी।
Tallinn से... Riga होते हुए... Vilnius तक।
तो इस देश को क्या मिलेगा?
लेकिन एक पेंच है: ये एक-दूसरे की भाषा समझते ही नहीं।
Latvian और Lithuanian रिश्तेदार भाषाएं हैं।
Estonian? वो तो Finnish के करीब है।
लेकिन ये अभी सबसे अजीब बात नहीं है।
लगभग six hundred साल पहले, अकेला Lithuania...
Europe का सबसे बड़ा देश था।
वो फैला था Baltic Sea से... Black Sea तक।
और आज? तीनों E-U में एक ही दिन शामिल हुए।
और Latvia बस एक बात कहता है।
तो... एक देश या तीन? क्योंकि सच बताऊं...
